codeMove clears the merge state only on a head move a chain of recorded pushes links; a synchronize ahead of its push webhook keeps the old head's state, and an approval of the new head reads it (ApprovalStands is true for the head itself) and can move to accepting on another head's clean. Store the head the state was read for, or clear it on any unlinked move.
